q: Does solvent recovery at a Mahad chemical unit change its carbon footprint?
title: Mahad solvent recovery and footprint
short: Yes, in two directions. Recovering solvent cuts purchased solvent, whose production carries emissions, but distillation uses steam and power. Count both: steam fuel and electricity in Scope 1 and 2, and avoided solvent purchases as lower Scope 3. Measure per batch.
audience: Chemical units in the Mahad industrial area

ul: Steam and power used by recovery columns.
Litres of solvent recovered and reused.
Fresh solvent bought before and after.

p: Energy for recovery adds to Scope 1 and 2. Buying less fresh solvent lowers Scope 3 category 1.
Use solvent factors from suppliers or a labelled database.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
